service.description:
Extract NetSuite sales orders for a reconciliation window over SuiteQL (REST Web Services), writing normalized JSON to the automation data-manager folder. Same in/out contract and same on-disk {records, metadata} file shape as the OMS and Shopify getters, so the automation edge and the Spark compare stage are unchanged (DAR-BE-032).
TRANSPORT: SuiteQL, not a SuiteScript RESTlet. Measured against a live account on 2026-09-02: 1000 rows per page (the documented ceiling, honoured) at ~880 rows/sec, so a 161k-order month enumerates in about three minutes. A RESTlet would additionally require a script record, a deployment and a role grant inside the CLIENT's production NetSuite and buys nothing for a presence check. No NetSuite-side deployment is needed for this service.
CREDENTIAL: the existing NsAuthConfig OAuth2 M2M profile, whose scope already defaults to "restlets rest_webservices". The SuiteQL endpoint host is derived from that profile's tokenUrl, so the account id is never configured twice and the request URL stays inside OutboundHttpPolicy's allow-list by construction.
POPULATION AND PROJECTION ARE CONFIGURATION (DAR-BE-044), not constants in the extractor. The record type, the table, the window column and the column-to-record-field mapping all come from the NsSuiteQlSourceQuery named by nsSuiteQlSourceQueryId. That is what lets one connector row serve every NetSuite pair, including the within-NetSuite pairs, instead of minting a systemEnumId, a connector row and an extract service per endpoint.
JOIN KEY: for the OMS order-presence pair the emitted orderId carries NetSuite's custbody_hc_order_id — the column the HotWax integration itself writes — so a match means "this NetSuite order came from that OMS order" rather than "these two strings are equal". Orders keyed in directly in NetSuite carry no such value; when the query declares an originFieldName every record also carries it (HOTWAX or NETSUITE_NATIVE) so those can be excluded by a configured rule, because an exclusion rule cannot match an absent field.
WINDOW: NetSuite's trandate is DATE-granular and stored in the account's timezone, so the window is applied as half-open [windowStart, windowEnd) on whole days. Give day-aligned windows; a sub-day window will not narrow the result.

parameter.name: nsSuiteQlSourceQueryId
parameter.description: Tenant-owned NsSuiteQlSourceQuery identifier. Says which NetSuite population this side enumerates (record type, table, window column) and how its columns map onto reconciliation record fields, and carries the NsAuthConfig that supplies the OAuth2 M2M credential and — via its tokenUrl host — the SuiteQL endpoint. Before DAR-BE-044 this parameter was the auth config directly and the population was hardcoded, which is why every new NetSuite pair needed a new service.

parameter.name: automationExecutionId
parameter.description: Automation execution id used to choose the default data-manager output folder.

parameter.name: companyUserGroupId
parameter.description: Trusted automation owner tenant. When present, config access is checked against this tenant instead of a user-session active tenant.

parameter.name: windowStart
parameter.description: Start of the window (inclusive); accepts Timestamp, ISO-8601 text, SQL timestamp text, epoch millis or yyyy-MM-dd. Reduced to a whole date.

parameter.name: windowEnd
parameter.description: End of the window, EXCLUSIVE — an order dated exactly at the bound belongs to the next window, so consecutive chunks do not double-count their boundary.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Optional output file name. Defaults to netsuite-orders-{from}-{thru}.json.

parameter.name: pageSize
parameter.description: Optional page size, capped at NetSuite's SuiteQL ceiling of 1000. A larger request is capped server-side anyway, which would otherwise make a caller believe it had read further than it had.

parameter.name: keepRecordFields
parameter.description: Optional projection: top-level record fields to keep in the output file. Applied after exclusion rules so narrowing the output cannot silently disable a rule. The connector no longer drives this — since DAR-BE-044 the field mapping IS the projection, exactly as the SELECT list is for DATABASE — but a direct caller may still narrow.

parameter.name: sourceFilters
parameter.description: Optional record-exclusion rules, same semantics as the OMS getters. These run client-side: SuiteQL has no knowledge of tenant exclusion rules.

parameter.name: reconciliationRunResultId
parameter.description: Optional observability run id for progress heartbeats. Advisory only.

parameter.name: progressStageCode
parameter.description: Which extract stage this run is: EXTRACT_FILE1 or EXTRACT_FILE2. Defaults to EXTRACT_FILE2.

parameter.name: expectedRecordCount
parameter.description: Optional expected total, which adds a progress percent alongside the count.
